[Pedagogy review · pf-b58d1ba31a]
Extend p12-q2 to connect cancellation with twice each original polynomial:
(g) Simplify [P(x)+Q(x)]+[P(x)−Q(x)].
(h) Simplify [P(x)+Q(x)]−[P(x)−Q(x)].
Answers: (g) 10x+4; (h) 2x²−6x+2.

[Pedagogy review · pf-81efd3147c]
Before p19-teaching, rehearse solving factored equations; the example lists roots directly and the guided sketch includes non-monic factors. Add:
(a) Solve (x−2)(x+3)=0.
(b) Solve x(x−4)=0.
(c) Solve (2x−3)(5−x)=0.
Answers: (a) 2, −3; (b) 0, 4; (c) 3/2, 5.

[Pedagogy review · pf-122b3bf92e]
Append to p30-q9: (c) Find a quadratic polynomial with roots −1 and 1 and y-intercept −2. (d) Compare its crossings with those in part b. Answers: (c) y=2(x−1)(x+1); (d) the quadratic crosses without flattening at both roots, whereas part b has flattened crossings. This keeps the intercepts fixed while comparing root multiplicity.
